blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The University of San Jose-Recoletos (USJ-R) Jaguars pulled off one of the biggest upsets in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 men’s basketball tournament, stunning the previously unbeaten Benedicto College (BC) Cheetahs, 62–60, in overtime on Thursday night, September 24, at the Cebu Coliseum.
